title: Count Words with a Given Prefix
real_world_story: A document analytics system groups words by their prefixes. For a given prefix, it must quickly determine how many indexed words begin with that prefix.

real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Trie prefix traversal with counts stored at Trie nodes

problem_statement: Given N words and a prefix, determine how many words in the collection begin with that prefix. Each occurrence of a word in the input is counted separately.
task: Build a Trie and return the number of input words whose prefix matches the requested prefix.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N. The second line contains N space-separated lowercase words. The third line contains the prefix.
output_format: Print the number of words that start with the given prefix.
constraints: Words contain only lowercase English letters

examples.input:
7
document documentation doctor dog download data database
doc

6
search storage system source service server
se

expected_algorithm.name: Trie Prefix Search
expected_algorithm.reason: A Trie can reach the node representing the prefix directly and store or aggregate the number of words passing through that node.

hint: Insert each word into the Trie.
Maintain a count for each Trie node representing how many inserted words pass through it.
Traverse the Trie using the prefix.
The count at the prefix node is the answer.
real_world_takeaway: Prefix counts can help document systems provide search statistics, filters, suggestions, and fast category-like grouping of text.
